images.prompt: Extreme close-up phone photograph of the printed surface of a slightly wrinkled white vinyl banner. The banner surface completely fills the entire square frame and extends past all four edges: no wall, no ceiling, no window, no floor, no shop interior, no border, no margin, no card, no frame, no drop shadow is visible anywhere. Printed across the vinyl: a cute rounded cartoon cloud mascot in mint green with pink cheeks and two small black dot eyes, a fat pink boba straw poking out of the top, three dark tapioca pearl dots beside it, and below the cloud the only text anywhere in the image, exactly: Boba Cloud Tea & Snow - hand-drawn rounded lettering in mint green with a pink outline, letter spacing slightly uneven, spelled exactly that way and nothing else written anywhere. One brass grommet at the very corner of the frame, a soft diagonal crease in the vinyl, a small scuff, faint dust. Shot straight on with a phone under bright flat overhead shop light, mild glare across the vinyl, flat unretouched phone-camera look, mixed white balance. Square crop, banner surface edge to edge. No other text, no watermarks, no hands, no people.

images.prompt: Amateur smartphone photo taken inside a small bubble tea shop and uploaded to a food delivery app. Wide view of the front counter: a completely blank white laminated board panel mounted above the counter with nothing printed on it, a stainless cup-sealing machine, a long row of clear plastic topping bins holding tapioca pearls and coloured jellies with small scoops in them, a tall stack of clear plastic cups, a plain glass jar, two wooden stools at a narrow window bar, worn scuffed tile floor, a plain unbranded stainless refrigerator with a blank door, a mop bucket in the corner. Bright flat overhead fluorescent light, high key, slight green colour cast, no fill, mixed white balance. Slightly crooked horizon, framed a little low, normal phone lens with no fisheye distortion, visible sensor noise and JPEG compression. Flat phone-camera look, unretouched, honest and ordinary. Absolutely no text, no lettering, no signage, no brand logos, no product packaging, no bottles, no labels, no watermarks, no hands, no people anywhere in the image.

images.prompt: Amateur smartphone photo taken by a restaurant employee to upload to a food delivery app, snapped quickly on the counter between orders. Subject: a generous pile of craggy golden fried popcorn chicken heaped in a paper boat lined with wax paper, crisp dark green fried basil leaves scattered through it, a dusting of reddish pepper seasoning, a small paper cup of pale dipping sauce wedged beside it. Harsh direct on-camera flash from a phone, hot blown-out white hotspot burning across the fried coating, hard ugly black shadow thrown flat behind the boat, flat fluorescent green-yellow cast in the corners of the frame. The boat sits directly on a scratched laminate shop counter with crumbs, a smear of sauce and a stack of plastic lids beside it, a napkin dispenser half out of frame. Framed crooked and too close, the boat cut off at the right edge, mild motion blur and soft focus, heavy JPEG compression artefacts and sensor noise, mixed white balance, flat and unretouched. Square crop. No text, no logos, no packaging labels, no watermarks, no hands, no people.
